title: Cloud Overlay - Cotton Silk Loose Fit
description: Nico Sera takes its name from the Italian word for evening, that golden hour when the day loosens its collar and the night begins. Made for late dinners, glowing rooms and the pleasure of getting dressed for what comes next. The Cloud Overlay brings an easy softness to evening dressing, with oversized black dots scattered across an ivory ground for a graphic take on a classic polka. Crafted in cotton silk, the fabric is light and fluid with a gentle sheen, giving the loose silhouette an effortless drape. The print shifts in scale across the piece, with larger dots through the front and sleeves and smaller ones along the collar and lower back, creating a considered play of proportion. Balloon sleeves and a shirt collar keep the shape relaxed, while silver toggles at the hem let you adjust the drape and add a subtle flash of shine. A tiny red star embroidered at the centre-back completes the look, making it an easy layer for dinners, evenings out and festive gatherings.

title: Revel Top - Bemberg Regular Fit
description: Nico Sera takes its name from the Italian word for evening, that golden hour when the day loosens its collar and the night begins. Made for late dinners, glowing rooms and the pleasure of getting dressed for what comes next. The Revel Top brings a quiet polish to everyday dressing, cut in black with a softly fluid silhouette and a little drama at the cuff. Crafted in Bemberg, the fabric is smooth, breathable and fluid, with a subtle sheen and an easy drape that moves beautifully with the body. Crafted from cotton linter, a natural byproduct of cottonseed oil production, Bemberg is a regenerated cellulose fibre that drapes like silk, is soft, breathable, and gentle on the skin. It’s biodegradable, compostable, and made using a closed-loop process that minimises waste, making it a thoughtful choice for you and the planet. The split neckline flows into a gathered tie-up detail, while raglan sleeves keep the shape relaxed and comfortable. Look closer at the details: the tie ends are finished with metal ends, a small red heart is embroidered at one end, and a black-and-white checked button closes each cuff. Made for workdays that turn into dinners, it slips easily between tailored trousers and more relaxed bottoms.

A ribbed collar and centre-front placket give the polo a clean, defined neckline, while horn buttons in a matching tone contribute a natural, tactile finish that lifts the shirt from mundane. A red star embroidery at the chest is a small mark of identity, consistent with the collection's artisanal thread. Inside the neckline, a polka-print twill tape on a beige base adds a concealed detail that speaks to the thought behind the construction. In a regular fit with half sleeves, the Midnight Polo T-shirt is built for travel, weekends, and every casual moment in between.

Gunmetal buttons at the placket and cuffs reinforce the shirt's grounded undertone, complemented by a denim twill tape finish under the sleeve placket and blue-and-white check trim on the inside yoke for a layered, thoughtful detail. A red star embroidery at the centre back yoke offers a small, signature finishing touch. Cut in a classic fit with a regular collar and full sleeves, this is a shirt that holds its own at a weekend brunch or an easy dinner with equal ease.

A Nicobar linen kurta underneath when the evening calls for layering. Wear it as it is. That’s the point.
